input.quote: 10.7 Entire Agreement. This Agreement is the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, superseding any prior agreements and communications (both written and oral) regarding such subject matter.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant of any kind. Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "employees" returned nothing, and a full read of the personnel-facing provision (Section 5.4, General Managers), the Exclusivity provisions (Sections 6.1-6.3, which restrict competing web projects and brand use, not hiring), the Cross-Promotion, Confidentiality, Warranty and General Provisions sections confirms no restriction on either Party approaching or hiring the other's staff. The integration clause in Section 10.7 confirms this Agreement is the complete and exclusive bargain, so no such covenant is imported from elsewhere. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicitation restriction on the Company), so no redline is warranted; the Section 6 exclusivity/non-compete terms are a separate commercial issue outside this rule.
